fact: Toll fees at the Busega, Kajjansi and Mpala plazas on the Kampala-Entebbe Expressway can now be paid by mobile money, launched with the Ministry of Works and Transport, per Tech Africa News.
Uganda's Ministry of Works and Transport said test runs of mobile money toll payment on the Kampala-Entebbe Expressway were complete and the service would launch soon, with no start date given.

fact: MTN Mobile Money and the Uganda Revenue Authority announced an enhanced URA tax and government payment menu on *165*18#, live nationwide.

The URA says digital payment options for tax now include EFT, RTGS, VISA, over-the-counter banking and mobile USSD *285#, and Local Excise Duty, Rental Income Tax and VAT returns moved to web-based platforms.

The 2023 Auditor General's report, as quoted by UPPC, says local government revenue rose 78 percent, from UGX 31.67 billion in 2019/20 to 56.35 billion in 2022/23, due to adopting online and mobile payment platforms.

fact: Habari Daily reports taxpayers can make digital payments of property rates, business licences, market dues and ground rent through IRAS, with electronic receipts, in local governments.
Kalisho Info reports that ECCMIS integrates online payment of court fees, fines, bail and deposits, in service in the Judiciary of Uganda's courts including the Cluster Eight rollout of 18 May 2026.
IRAS, an online and mobile platform, lets local governments collect revenue through registration, assessment, billing and payment, and was in use in 124 local governments by October 2023.
